tools.name: claix.schemas.list
tools.title: List Claix schemas
tools.description: List the Claix schemas available for the authenticated account. Returns id, name, type, schema_definition, is_agent_mode, and agent_definition. Call this first whenever you need a schema_id before claix.extract.* or claix.agent.* tools.

api_key.description: API key secreta de Claix. Ejemplo: claix_sk_abc123.... Opcional si la conexión MCP envía x-api-key en cabecera HTTP (recomendado en Smithery/Cursor).

success.description: True when Claix returned a successful response. False when isError is set on the tool result.

data.description: JSON payload from the Claix API (extracted records, schema list, or Excel export metadata).

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

tools.name: claix.schemas.create
tools.title: Create Claix schema
tools.description: Create a Claix schema (POST /api/create-schema). Requires name, type (excel-json, json-excel, pdf-json, doc-json, img-json, txt-json, audio-json) and schema_definition. Optional: is_agent_mode, agent_definition, resumen_agent, window_context, window_time (minutes or "infinity" for Persistent Mode), source verification (default false).

api_key.description: API key secreta de Claix. Ejemplo: claix_sk_abc123.... Opcional si la conexión MCP envía x-api-key en cabecera HTTP (recomendado en Smithery/Cursor).

name.description: Human-readable schema name. Example: Facturas HTML.

type.description: Schema type matching an extraction endpoint. Example: txt-json, pdf-json.

schema_definition.description: Output fields. Each key is a JSON property; each value is { type: "string"|"integer"|"number"|"boolean", description: "..." }.

is_agent_mode.description: Set true to enable Agent mode. json-excel cannot use Agent mode.

agent_definition.description: Required if is_agent_mode is true. Types: boolean, string, closed, integer. closed requires options[].

window_context.description: If true, persist document markdown for later Q&A.

window_time.description: Required if window_context is true. Duration in minutes: 5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180, 240, 360, 480, 720, 1440; or the string infinity (stored as 0, requires Persistent Mode).

cita_por_campo.description: Enables source verification: each extracted field (and agent_data) is returned as {value, source} instead of a bare value. Defaults to false.

success.description: True when Claix returned a successful response. False when isError is set on the tool result.

data.description: JSON payload from the Claix API (extracted records, schema list, or Excel export metadata).

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

space_id.description: Opcional. UUID del espacio de conocimiento donde agrupar el documento guardado. Ejemplo: 5b9e2c14-7d3a-4f8b-9e1c-6a0d4b8f2e7c. Debe pertenecer a la misma cuenta de la API key. Solo tiene efecto si el schema tiene la ventana de contexto activada, que es cuando el documento se guarda. Después puedes preguntar a todo el espacio con claix.space_context.ask.

success.description: True when Claix returned a successful response. False when isError is set on the tool result.

data.description: JSON payload from the Claix API (extracted records, schema list, or Excel export metadata).

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

tools.name: claix.window_context.get
tools.title: Get persisted document content
tools.description: Retrieve raw content and metadata from a persisted document (GET /get-document/{document_id}). Requires document_id from an extraction with window_context. Returns success, document_id, file_name, schema_id, processed_at, and content. Free call.

api_key.description: API key secreta de Claix. Ejemplo: claix_sk_abc123.... Opcional si la conexión MCP envía x-api-key en cabecera HTTP (recomendado en Smithery/Cursor).

document_id.description: UUID del documento persistido (document_id de una extracción con window_context). Ejemplo: 3c7a9f21-4b8e-4d1a-9c6f-2e0d8a5b7c4f.

success.description: True when Claix returned a successful response. False when isError is set on the tool result.

data.description: JSON payload from the Claix API (extracted records, schema list, or Excel export metadata).

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

tools.name: claix.window_context.ask
tools.title: Ask a persisted document (context window)
tools.description: Ask up to 5 typed questions about a persisted document (POST /document-context/{document_id}). Requires document_id from an extraction with window_context. Each item is { question, format } where format is string|int|boolean|timestamp|array; question max 400 characters. Returns user_ask (echoed with format), typed ia_response, and log_id (null if not in the document). If source verification is enabled on document queries, each ia_response item is {value, source} citing markdown evidence, or source is requires_human_revision.

api_key.description: API key secreta de Claix. Ejemplo: claix_sk_abc123.... Opcional si la conexión MCP envía x-api-key en cabecera HTTP (recomendado en Smithery/Cursor).

document_id.description: UUID del documento persistido (document_id de una extracción con window_context). Ejemplo: 3c7a9f21-4b8e-4d1a-9c6f-2e0d8a5b7c4f.

question.description: Question text to answer from the persisted markdown only.

format.description: Expected JSON type for the matching ia_response item: string, int, boolean, timestamp, or array.

items.description: Typed question. Example: {"question":"¿Cuál es la penalización por cancelación anticipada?","format":"string"}

questions.description: Questions as objects { question, format }. Max 5 per call, 400 characters per question. format ∈ string|int|boolean|timestamp|array. Example: [{"question":"¿Cuál es el importe total?","format":"int"}]

success.description: True when Claix returned a successful response. False when isError is set on the tool result.

data.description: JSON payload from the Claix API (extracted records, schema list, or Excel export metadata).

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

tools.name: claix.spaces.create
tools.title: Create a knowledge space
tools.description: Create a knowledge space to group persisted documents (POST /create-space). The only field is name. Returns space_id, name, and created_at. Pass that space_id as the optional space_id when extracting, then query the whole group with claix.space_context.ask. Free call.

api_key.description: API key secreta de Claix. Ejemplo: claix_sk_abc123.... Opcional si la conexión MCP envía x-api-key en cabecera HTTP (recomendado en Smithery/Cursor).

name.description: Nombre del espacio de conocimiento. Único campo de entrada, máximo 200 caracteres. Ejemplo: "Proveedores 2026".

success.description: True when Claix returned a successful response. False when isError is set on the tool result.

data.description: JSON payload from the Claix API (extracted records, schema list, or Excel export metadata).

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

tools.name: claix.spaces.delete
tools.title: Delete a knowledge space
tools.description: Delete a knowledge space owned by the API key (DELETE /delete-space/{space_id}). No body or query params. Returns { space_id } on success. Irreversible. Free call. 404 if the space does not exist or belongs to another account.

api_key.description: API key secreta de Claix. Ejemplo: claix_sk_abc123.... Opcional si la conexión MCP envía x-api-key en cabecera HTTP (recomendado en Smithery/Cursor).

space_id.description: UUID del espacio de conocimiento. Es el mismo valor que se envía como space_id opcional al extraer para agrupar documentos, y el que devuelve claix.spaces.create. Ejemplo: 5b9e2c14-7d3a-4f8b-9e1c-6a0d4b8f2e7c.

data.description: JSON payload from the Claix API (extracted records, schema list, or Excel export metadata).

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

tools.name: claix.space_context.ask
tools.title: Ask a knowledge space (cross-document context)
tools.description: Ask up to 5 typed questions across every document grouped in a knowledge space (POST /space-context/{space_id}). Same input and output as claix.window_context.ask: questions[] of { question, format } (format: string|int|boolean|timestamp|array), but the answer is built by cross-referencing all the documents in the space instead of a single one, so use it to compare, add up, or reconcile data spread over several files. Requires space_id, the same one passed as the optional space_id when extracting. Question max 400 characters. Returns user_ask, typed ia_response, and log_id (null if the answer is in none of the documents). If source verification is enabled on knowledge space queries, each ia_response item is {value, source} naming document_id and file_name.

api_key.description: API key secreta de Claix. Ejemplo: claix_sk_abc123.... Opcional si la conexión MCP envía x-api-key en cabecera HTTP (recomendado en Smithery/Cursor).

space_id.description: UUID del espacio de conocimiento. Es el mismo valor que se envía como space_id opcional al extraer para agrupar documentos, y el que devuelve claix.spaces.create. Ejemplo: 5b9e2c14-7d3a-4f8b-9e1c-6a0d4b8f2e7c.

questions.description: Questions as objects { question, format }. Max 5 per call, 400 characters per question. format ∈ string|int|boolean|timestamp|array. Example: [{"question":"¿Cuál es el importe total?","format":"int"}]

tools.name: claix.document.replace
tools.title: Replace a document's content
tools.description: Replace the content of a persisted document with another document's content (POST /replace-document). Body: document_id (kept) and new_content_document_id (source, deleted after copy). Records a swap, bumps version, and returns swap_id, version, and swaps_count. Free call.

new_content_document_id.description: UUID of the source document whose file_name and markdown_content will be copied onto document_id. Deleted after a successful replace. Example: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890.
